display.purpose: The landing page's single hero headline only. Nowhere else.

headline.purpose: Page-level view titles (Discover, Workspace, Admin, etc.).

body.purpose: Default text everywhere; the implicit browser/RN default, not an explicit override.

label.purpose: Buttons, tabs, status pills, badge counts — emphasis via weight, not size.

shadows.name: resting
shadows.purpose: Default panel/card shadow at rest. Dark mode: 0 16px 36px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.26).

shadows.name: lifted
shadows.purpose: property-card hover only. Dark mode: 0 24px 60px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.36).

motion.name: ease-standard
motion.purpose: The one easing token (--ease) used for property-card hover transform/shadow transitions.

motion.name: button-lift
motion.purpose: Buttons/tabs translateY(-1px) on hover — the only hover treatment they get.

breakpoints.name: narrow
breakpoints.purpose: Where the landing hero's clamp() steps down and the header switches to a stacked layout. No named breakpoint tokens exist; this is an observed threshold, not a declared variable.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Main call-to-action button — Registry Green fill, bold white label.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #003d00; color: #ffffff; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 6px; padding: 8px 12px; min-height: 38px; font-weight: 800; line-height: 1.1; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 0.15s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgba(0, 61, 0, 0.22); border-color: #003d00; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Lower-emphasis action — white surface, line border, ink text.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { background: #ffffff; color: #000000; border: 1px solid #dcdcda; border-radius: 6px; padding: 8px 12px; min-height: 38px; font-weight: 800; line-height: 1.1; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 0.15s; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { transform: translateY(-1px); }

components.name: Danger Button
components.description: Destructive action — Flag Red fill, same shape as primary.
components.css: .ds-btn-danger { background: #ce1126; color: #ffffff; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 6px; padding: 8px 12px; min-height: 38px; font-weight: 800; line-height: 1.1; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 0.15s; } .ds-btn-danger:hover { transform: translateY(-1px); }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Standard field — white surface, line border, dual-signal focus.
components.css: .ds-input { width: 100%; min-height: 40px; border: 1px solid #dcdcda; border-radius: 6px; padding: 8px 12px; background: #ffffff; color: #000000; } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgba(0, 61, 0, 0.22); border-color: #003d00; }

components.name: Property Card
components.description: The signature content card — flat at rest, lifts and gains a stronger shadow on hover.
components.css: .ds-property-card { min-width: 0; overflow: hidden; border: 1px solid #dcdcda; border-radius: 8px; background: #ffffff; box-shadow: 0 16px 36px rgba(10, 10, 10, 0.08); cursor: pointer; transition: transform 0.18s cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1), box-shadow 0.18s cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1); } .ds-property-card:hover { transform: translateY(-3px); box-shadow: 0 22px 54px rgba(10, 10, 10, 0.14); } .ds-property-photo { aspect-ratio: 16 / 10; background: #eef0ee; } .ds-property-body { padding: 18px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px; font-weight: 400; } .ds-property-body strong { font-weight: 700; }

components.name: Nav Tab
components.description: Inline nav tab — transparent/muted at rest, solid green fill when active.
components.css: .ds-tabs { display: flex; gap: 6px; } .ds-tab { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; background: transparent; color: #5c5c59; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 6px; padding: 8px 12px; min-height: 38px; font-weight: 800; cursor: pointer; } .ds-tab-active { background: #003d00; color: #ffffff; }

components.name: Badge Count
components.description: The only fully-round shape in the system — a small red numeric count, e.g. unread notifications.
components.css: .ds-badge-count { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-width: 18px; height: 18px; padding: 0 5px; border-radius: 999px; background: #ce1126; color: #ffffff; font-size: 0.7rem; font-weight: 800; }

components.name: Status Pill
components.description: Text-color-only status indicator — no fill, no border. Amber for suspended, red for banned.

components.name: Landing Sticker Badge
components.description: Landing page only. A tilted, thick-stroked decal (e.g. 'Karibu Nyumbani') sitting above the hero headline - a physical sticker object, not a typographic eyebrow/kicker.
components.css: .ds-sticker { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; background: #f0a500; color: #17130d; border: 3px solid #17130d; border-radius: 999px; padding: 7px 16px 7px 12px; transform: rotate(-3deg); box-shadow: 3px 3px 0 #17130d; font-family: 'Work Sans', sans-serif; font-weight: 800; font-size: 0.78rem; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.06em; }

components.name: Landing CTA + Ghost Link
components.description: Landing page only. Bungee/Work Sans world's primary action pair - a hard-shadow pill button plus a gold-underlined text link, in that order, above the trust badges.
components.html: See how it works
components.css: .ds-landing-actions { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 14px; flex-wrap: wrap; } .ds-landing-cta { font-family: 'Work Sans', sans-serif; font-weight: 800; background: #d21023; color: #fffaf0; border: 3px solid #17130d; border-radius: 999px; box-shadow: 6px 6px 0 #17130d; padding: 15px 30px; } .ds-landing-ghost { font-family: 'Work Sans', sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 0.96rem; text-decoration: underline; text-decoration-color: #f0a500; text-decoration-thickness: 3px; text-underline-offset: 5px; color: #17130d; }

components.name: Flip-Mode Testimonials Card
components.description: Landing page only. Half-width (max 620px), and inverts relative to the page's own light/dark mode - dark card on the light page, light card on the dark page - via its own --mp-band* tokens, distinct from the page-wide ink/paper pair. Accent colors differ by direction (gold/red on dark, red/green on light) for contrast, not a literal inversion of the same two hues.
components.html:
What our users say

No shared experiences yet - real tenant, landlord, agency, and mover stories will show up here as they come in.
components.css: .ds-testimonial-card { max-width: 620px; padding: 24px; border-radius: 20px; background: #17130d; } .ds-testimonial-card h3 { margin: 0 0 4px; color: #ffc93c; font-family: Bungee, sans-serif; text-transform: uppercase; font-size: 1.1rem; } .ds-testimonial-empty { margin: 0; padding: 14px 16px; border: 2.5px dashed rgba(255,201,60,0.55); border-radius: 12px; color: #f3ead2; font-family: 'Work Sans', sans-serif; font-size: 0.92rem; }

narrative.overview:
KejaApp's current, shipped visual system reads like a well-run civic registry office, not a marketplace app performing trust — plain type, the Kenyan flag's own palette carried at low saturation, small radii, and almost no decoration beyond what a state changes (a border tint on a warning, a color shift on a status pill). Nothing asks to be noticed for its own sake; the design gets out of the way of the actual task, which fits a product whose whole legal positioning is staying out of the tenancy and the money entirely. Depth is rare and earned — panels sit flat until a property card is actually interactive under a cursor, and only then does it lift.

There is no confirmed anti-reference on file; "flashy fintech/marketplace" was considered as a naming point during this document's own drafting but was not adopted as a stated rejection, so treat it as absent rather than binding.
keyCharacteristics: Flag-derived palette (black, white, red, dark green) at restrained saturation, applied as accent, not wallpaper - plus one non-flag warning amber.
One typographic voice for the whole system — no separate display face; hierarchy comes from size and weight alone.
Small, consistent radii (6-8px); a single 999px pill for counts and status only.
Flat by default; shadow appears only as a response to hover/interaction, never as ambient decoration.
Heavily bold (700-900 weight) labels on buttons and badges, ordinary weight everywhere else.

rules.name: The Accent-on-State Rule
rules.body: Green, red, and amber only ever appear attached to a specific state or action — never as a decorative fill, gradient, or background wash.

rules.name: The Shout-Don't-Grow Rule
rules.body: Interactive labels get heavy weight (800-900), not larger size, to stand out from body text.

rules.name: The Earned-Shadow Rule
rules.body: A stronger shadow is a response to interaction (hover), never an ambient decoration applied at rest.

rules.name: The Scoped-World Rule
rules.body: A surface may run its own visual world entirely apart from the global system (the landing page's matatu-poster identity vs. the rest of the app's County Registry), but only by explicit commission, never by a builder's default - and it doesn't leak to any other route without the same kind of deliberate decision.

dos: Do reach for weight (700-900) before size or color when a label needs emphasis.
Do keep shadows a response to hover/interaction, never an ambient resting decoration.
Do keep the accent colors (green/red/amber) tied to a specific action or state.
Do use the 6px/8px radius pair for nearly everything; reserve 999px for counts and fully-round pills only.
Do treat a commissioned surface-scoped world (like the landing page's) as owned by that surface only - reference its own tokens, not the global ones, and vice versa.
donts: Don't assume web's and mobile's "same" brand colors already match - they currently don't.
Don't treat Calibri as a meaningful part of the type identity - it's a stale leading fallback most visitors never actually render.
Don't invent a second display typeface without updating this file first.
Don't add a spacing/breakpoint token system to only one platform's file.
Don't reuse the gold accent for text on the testimonials card's light-mode state - it measures ~1.8:1 on cream, well under WCAG AA; use red/green for that direction of the flip instead.
